verdicts_or_reports.element: Indent.md entry in the favourites list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Unmarking Indent.md should remove it from the Favourites list immediately.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After tapping the remove-favourite action, Indent.md remained displayed in the selected Favourites list. It disappeared only after navigating out of Favourites and returning.
steps: Open the notebook folder and long-press Indent.md.
Tap Favourite to mark it, then open Go to → Favourites.
Long-press Indent.md in Favourites and tap the remove-favourite action.
Observe that Indent.md is still listed; navigate out and back to confirm it is then gone.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Search field and its option controls
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Search options such as Match Case, Match Whole Word, and Use Regular Expression should be placed above the Search input; Preserve Case should be above the Replace input.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The option controls are positioned in the same horizontal rows as the Search and Replace inputs, to their right, in both portrait and landscape.
steps: Open Regex2.md in the editor and tap Search.
Observe the Search options on the same row to the right of the Search field and Preserve Case on the same row to the right of Replace.
Rotate to landscape and confirm the options remain beside the fields.

verdicts_or_reports.field: Selected sort criterion after toggling Folder local
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Turning Folder local off should only change that checkbox and leave Name selected as the sort criterion.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Turning Folder local off also selected MIME type and deselected Name.
steps: Open the notebook folder with Name selected in Sort by.
Open Sort by and enable Folder local.
Tap the Folder local checkbox again to disable it.
Observe that MIME type becomes selected and Name is no longer selected.
